By synthesizing research on physics education outreach, pharmaceutical agentic workflows, and legal frameworks for durable power of attorney, we map how mechanical constraints—rather than inherent consciousness—enable continuity and boundary-setting. We move to refine these findings by investigating specific mechanisms for cross-turn state persistence in LLM-based autonomous architectures.
